historical_note: Catalog note: this identity, label, and Microsoft attribution are documented in Microsoft's historical source snapshot of 2025-05-30. This source does not establish the application's current name, ownership, or availability.

summaries.text: Identifies Microsoft's own SharePoint and OneDrive application instance.
Supports rights-management encryption, including encryption associated with Purview labeling.
Registers an application in a customer tenant for each enrolled network-scanning agent.
Supports third-party Teams message extensions, including polling and survey applications.
Supports cloud-based machine-learning development and lifecycle management.
Supports commerce workflows for Microsoft's transactional volume-licensing agreements.
Supports remote access to privately hosted applications through Entra Application Proxy and Private Access workflows.
Relates to managed SQL Server capabilities hosted in an isolated cloud network.
Provides cloud security monitoring and automated security-response capabilities.
Supports Global Secure Access administration for evaluating network changes and features before affecting onboarded environments.
Supports programmatic administration of storage accounts and their keys.
Manages identities associated with Fabric workspaces.
Applies application-protection policies that can disable service principals. Its documented role does not require creating application registrations or principals.
Manages application objects in specifically permitted Microsoft internal service and infrastructure tenants.
Supports application access management and single sign-on for business applications.
Creates an application registration when requested during Azure Bot Service resource provisioning.
